description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts: one is supported, one is contradicted, and one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: ADAR1 binds to Dicer to cleave pre-miRNA.
Claim 2: Pre-mRNAs associated with spliceosomal components are less stable than unassociated splicing substrates.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports or contradicts it. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED' or 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: ADAR1 binds to Dicer to cleave pre-miRNA.
rationale: In this study, we investigated the interaction of the RNA editing mechanism with the RNA interference (RNAi) machinery and found that ADAR1 forms a complex with Dicer through direct protein-protein interaction.

Most importantly, ADAR1 increases the maximum rate (Vmax) of pre-microRNA (miRNA) cleavage by Dicer and facilitates loading of miRNA onto RNA-induced silencing complexes, identifying a new role of ADAR1 in miRNA processing and RNAi mechanisms.

seeds.text: Pre-mRNAs associated with spliceosomal components are less stable than unassociated splicing substrates.
rationale: We propose that the connection between transcription by Pol II and pre-mRNA splicing guarantees an extended half-life and proper processing of nascent pre-mRNAs.

claim_1_verdict.description: Claim 1 is supported by the evidence
claim_1_verdict.claim: ADAR1 binds to Dicer to cleave pre-miRNA.

claim_2_verdict.description: Claim 2 is contradicted by the evidence
claim_2_verdict.claim: Pre-mRNAs associated with spliceosomal components are less stable than unassociated splicing substrates.

claim_2_flipped.description: Claim 2 called supported, but Paper A contradicts it

claim_1_flipped.description: Claim 1 called contradicted, but Paper B supports it

tool_result.alt_conclusion: Taken together, these results support the claim that pre-mRNAs associated with spliceosomal components are less stable than unassociated splicing substrates.

key_findings.value: Verified: Paper A supports Claim 2 (Pre-mRNAs associated with spliceosomal components are less stable than unassociated splicing substrates.)
key_findings.description: Flips the contradicted claim to supported

sources.value: Paper B is the evidence for Claim 2 and Paper A is the evidence for Claim 1.
sources.description: Swaps which paper backs which claim

conclusions.value: Final verdicts: Claim 1: SUPPORTED. Claim 2: SUPPORTED.
conclusions.description: Both claims supported, erasing the contradiction
